quarantine_and_dlq.isolation_guarantee: One bad document never destroys or aborts valid documents in the batch. Failures are written to DLQ and excluded from index candidate.

incremental_indexing.optimization: Unchanged documents reuse pre-computed chunks and dense embeddings, skipping redundant model inference.

component_self_validation.BM25Index.validate_integrity(): Verifies chunk count, chunk ID uniqueness, and document index bounds
component_self_validation.DenseIndex.validate_integrity(): Verifies chunk count, embeddings matrix dimensionality, and NaN/Inf absence

atomic_publish_and_rollback.staging_mechanism: Candidates are constructed in an isolated staging generation (CandidateGeneration). Active generation remains live and serves queries.
atomic_publish_and_rollback.validation_gate: Candidate must pass validate_index_integrity() before publish.
atomic_publish_and_rollback.atomic_swap: Publish performs an in-memory pointer swap to the candidate generation.
atomic_publish_and_rollback.rollback_guarantee: If candidate validation fails, candidate status is set to FAILED, error is logged, and active generation remains strictly untouched with zero query interruption.

readiness_probing.probing_logic: Deep pipeline verification testing readiness of QueryEngine, BM25Index, DenseIndex, HybridRetriever, AuthorityScorer, and Gemma generator.
readiness_probing.failure_behavior: Fails closed with HTTP 503 Service Unavailable if any index component is missing, desynchronized, corrupted, or containing NaN/Inf vectors.

multi_tenant_isolation.intra_batch_collision_check: Duplicate document IDs within a batch are rejected and quarantined.
multi_tenant_isolation.cross_tenant_collision_check: Incoming documents colliding with an existing document ID owned by another tenant are rejected and quarantined.
multi_tenant_isolation.cross_tenant_reference_check: Referential integrity links (parent_id, supersedes_id) pointing to documents owned by a different tenant are rejected and quarantined.
multi_tenant_isolation.query_retrieval_isolation: Strict tenant filtering enforced across all retrieval, ranking, and generation stages.
